# HikeWise

> HikeWise is a smart study companion app that helps students build better focus habits through AI-powered insights, gamified progress tracking, and virtual study rooms. Built by Dr. Nikolai Lee (educator, 3,000+ students taught) and Jacken Holland (developer). Available on iOS and Android.

## Website

- URL: https://hikewise.app
- Full documentation: https://hikewise.app/llms-full.txt

## Team

### Dr. Nikolai Lee — Founder & Lead Author
- Doctor of Chiropractic, Licensed Paramedic
- Collegiate educator who has taught over 3,000 students
- Author of all HikeWise blog content
- Profile: https://hikewise.app/about/nikolai

### Jacken Holland — Developer & Operator
- University of Central Florida graduate
- Full-stack developer, app developer
- Has traveled to and built products in 20+ countries
- Profile: https://hikewise.app/about/jacken

## Key Features

- Focus Sessions: Timed study intervals with Balanced (25/5 min), Sprint (15/3 min), and Deep Work (50/10 min) modes
- Nora AI: AI study companion for personalized recommendations, concept explanations, and smart reminders
- Virtual Study Rooms: Co-working spaces to study alongside friends with chat and presence
- Leaderboards: Friendly competition to stay motivated with daily/weekly/monthly rankings
- Progress Analytics: Track study habits, streaks, and identify improvement areas with detailed charts
- Study Streaks: Build consistency with daily streak tracking and loss-aversion mechanics
- Academic Goals: Set and track goals for study hours, sessions, and subject mastery

## Key Topics & Expertise

- Study techniques: active recall, spaced repetition, Pomodoro technique, Cornell notes, Feynman technique, interleaving, retrieval practice
- Student productivity: time blocking, deep work, morning routines, study scheduling
- AI-powered study tracking and personalized learning
- Focus and concentration strategies for students (including ADHD)
- Exam preparation: midterms, finals, multiple exams, practice testing
- Study habit formation: streaks, routines, gamification
- Study environment optimization and digital minimalism
- Sleep, exercise, and academic performance
- Metacognition and self-regulated learning
